## Loading Data
```{r}
read_clean <- function(file_path) {
  df <- read.csv(file_path, header = TRUE, na.strings = c("", "NA"), stringsAsFactors = TRUE)
  df[df == "NA"] <- NA
  return(df)
}

cessationtrain_num_ohe <- read_clean("cessationtrain_num_ohe.csv")
```

## Variable Types
```{r}
# NOTE: factor_vars_master (the ROOT categorical variable names, e.g.
# "EducationRc") is only needed when typing cessationtrain/cessationtest
# (non-OHE). This script only loads cessationtrain_num_ohe, so it's omitted.
#
# In cessationtrain_num_ohe / cessationtest_num_ohe, a column is a one-hot
# dummy (factor) if and only if "." appears in its column name
# (e.g. "EducationRc.2"); everything else is numeric.

factor_vars_ohe  <- grep("\\.", names(cessationtrain_num_ohe), value = TRUE)
numeric_vars_all <- setdiff(names(cessationtrain_num_ohe), c("ID", "QuA1Rc", factor_vars_ohe))

cessationtrain_num_ohe[factor_vars_ohe] <- lapply(cessationtrain_num_ohe[factor_vars_ohe], as.factor)
cessationtrain_num_ohe[numeric_vars_all] <- lapply(cessationtrain_num_ohe[numeric_vars_all], as.numeric)

cessationtrain_num_ohe$QuA1Rc <- as.factor(cessationtrain_num_ohe$QuA1Rc)

cat("Identified", length(factor_vars_ohe), "one-hot factor dummy columns and",
    length(numeric_vars_all), "numeric columns.\n")
```

## Selection Function: T-test + Fisher's + Logistic Regression, Intersected
```{r}
# Mirrors original pipeline exactly: t-test (numeric) + Fisher's exact
# (one-hot factor dummies) intersected with univariate logistic
# regression on ALL predictors. Final "sig_vars" set, then expanded back
# to include every dummy level of any root variable that was significant.

run_selection <- function(data, factor_vars, numeric_vars, alpha = 0.05) {

  #T-tests (numeric variables)
  t_results <- lapply(numeric_vars, function(var) {
    df <- data.frame(value = data[[var]], group = as.factor(data$QuA1Rc))
    df <- df[!is.na(df$value) & !is.na(df$group), ]

    if (length(unique(df$group)) == 2 && all(table(df$group) > 1)) {
      lev <- tryCatch(leveneTest(value ~ group, data = df), error = function(e) NULL)
      if (is.null(lev)) return(data.frame(variable = var, p_value_ttest = NA_real_))
      equal_var <- lev$`Pr(>F)`[1] > 0.05

      ttest <- tryCatch(t.test(value ~ group, data = df, var.equal = equal_var),
                         error = function(e) NULL)
      if (is.null(ttest)) return(data.frame(variable = var, p_value_ttest = NA_real_))

      data.frame(variable = var, p_value_ttest = ttest$p.value)
    } else {
      data.frame(variable = var, p_value_ttest = NA_real_)
    }
  })
  t_tests <- do.call(rbind, t_results)
  ttest_vars <- t_tests$variable[!is.na(t_tests$p_value_ttest) & t_tests$p_value_ttest < alpha]

  #Fisher's exact tests (one-hot factor dummies)
  fisher_results <- lapply(factor_vars, function(var) {
    df <- data.frame(var_value = data[[var]], group = data$QuA1Rc) %>%
      filter(!is.na(var_value) & !is.na(group))

    tbl <- table(df$var_value, df$group)

    if (nrow(tbl) > 1 && ncol(tbl) > 1) {
      test <- tryCatch(fisher.test(tbl), error = function(e) NULL)
      if (is.null(test)) return(data.frame(variable = var, p_value_fisher = NA_real_))
      data.frame(variable = var, p_value_fisher = test$p.value)
    } else {
      data.frame(variable = var, p_value_fisher = NA_real_)
    }
  })
  fisher_tests <- do.call(rbind, fisher_results)
  fisher_vars <- fisher_tests$variable[!is.na(fisher_tests$p_value_fisher) & fisher_tests$p_value_fisher < alpha]

  t_fisher_vars <- union(ttest_vars, fisher_vars)

  #Univariate logistic regression (all predictors)
  quit <- "QuA1Rc"
  data[[quit]] <- factor(data[[quit]], levels = c(2, 1), labels = c(0, 1))
  predictors <- setdiff(names(data), c("ID", quit))

  log_results <- vector("list", length(predictors))
  for (i in seq_along(predictors)) {
    var <- predictors[i]
    formula <- as.formula(paste(quit, "~", var))
    fit <- tryCatch(glm(formula, data = data, family = binomial), error = function(e) NULL)

    if (is.null(fit)) {
      log_results[[i]] <- data.frame(variable = var, p_value = NA_real_)
      next
    }
    coef_summary <- summary(fit)$coefficients
    if (nrow(coef_summary) < 2) {
      log_results[[i]] <- data.frame(variable = var, p_value = NA_real_)
      next
    }
    log_results[[i]] <- data.frame(variable = var, p_value = coef_summary[2, "Pr(>|z|)"])
  }
  logreg_tests <- do.call(rbind, log_results)
  logreg_vars <- logreg_tests$variable[!is.na(logreg_tests$p_value) & logreg_tests$p_value < alpha]

  #Intersection: must be significant in (t-test OR Fisher's) AND logistic
  sig_vars <- intersect(t_fisher_vars, logreg_vars)

  #Collapse to root variable names, then re-expand to all dummy levels
  keep_vars <- unique(sub("\\..*", "", sig_vars))
  full_vars <- unique(unlist(lapply(keep_vars, function(root) {
    grep(paste0("^", root, "(\\.|$)"), names(data), value = TRUE)
  })))

  full_vars
}
```

## Stratified Bootstrap
```{r}
n_boot <- 1000
seed <- 842
alpha_threshold <- 0.05

idx_by_class <- split(seq_len(nrow(cessationtrain_num_ohe)), cessationtrain_num_ohe$QuA1Rc)

set.seed(seed)
boot_selected <- vector("list", n_boot)

for (b in seq_len(n_boot)) {
  #stratified resample WITH replacement, within each class, at original class size
  #preserves the exact class imbalance ratio in every bootstrap draw
  boot_idx <- unlist(lapply(idx_by_class, function(idx) sample(idx, length(idx), replace = TRUE)))
  boot_sample <- cessationtrain_num_ohe[boot_idx, ]

  boot_selected[[b]] <- tryCatch(
    run_selection(
      data = boot_sample,
      factor_vars = factor_vars_ohe,
      numeric_vars = numeric_vars_all,
      alpha = alpha_threshold
    ),
    error = function(e) character(0)  # if a resample fails (e.g. degenerate table), record no selections
  )

  if (b %% 50 == 0) cat("Completed bootstrap", b, "of", n_boot, "\n")
}
```

## Tabulate Selection Frequency
```{r}
all_vars_selected <- unlist(boot_selected)

stability_table <- as.data.frame(table(all_vars_selected)) %>%
  rename(variable = all_vars_selected, times_selected = Freq) %>%
  mutate(pct_bootstraps = times_selected / n_boot) %>%
  arrange(desc(pct_bootstraps))

# add back variables that were NEVER selected in any bootstrap, at 0%
all_candidate_vars <- names(cessationtrain_num_ohe) %>% setdiff(c("ID", "QuA1Rc"))
never_selected <- setdiff(all_candidate_vars, stability_table$variable)
if (length(never_selected) > 0) {
  stability_table <- bind_rows(
    stability_table,
    data.frame(variable = never_selected, times_selected = 0, pct_bootstraps = 0)
  )
}

print(stability_table)
write.csv(stability_table, "~/Desktop/LV-main/bootstrap_feature_stability.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```

## Compare Against Original Single-Split Selection
```{r}
#ran the same selection once on the full (non-bootstrapped) training set, to see how the original paper's feature set lines up with bootstrap stability
original_selected <- run_selection(
  data = cessationtrain_num_ohe,
  factor_vars = factor_vars_ohe,
  numeric_vars = numeric_vars_all,
  alpha = alpha_threshold
)

cat("\nOriginal single-split selected", length(original_selected), "variables (dummy-level count).\n")

comparison_table <- stability_table %>%
  mutate(in_original_selection = variable %in% original_selected) %>%
  arrange(desc(pct_bootstraps))

print(comparison_table)
write.csv(comparison_table, "~/Desktop/LV-main/bootstrap_vs_original_selection.csv", row.names = FALSE)

cat("\nOriginally-selected variables also selected in >=80% of bootstraps (stable):\n")
print(comparison_table$variable[comparison_table$in_original_selection & comparison_table$pct_bootstraps >= 0.8])

cat("\nOriginally-selected variables selected in <50% of bootstraps (fragile):\n")
print(comparison_table$variable[comparison_table$in_original_selection & comparison_table$pct_bootstraps < 0.5])
```
